Name: Sesi's Playground (Unofficial Update)
Author: namidaame
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]There are surprisingly few mods that add any sort of playground equipment. As in, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25322]Sesi's Playground[/url] was pretty much the only one I found, and it used an older version of Furniture Framework. But I was determined to have my little playground, so here we are! This is my first foray into making Stardew mods so please let me know if anything isn't working right.[/color][/size]

The original included an Italian version, but since I tweaked some of the English names and I don't speak Italian, I did not include that here.

All textures and images come from the original mod, with only small changes to make layers work better.

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url].[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]If you want the flooring options, install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url].[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]If you want the playground equipment, install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23458]Furniture Framework[/url].[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Unzip this mod's files into your Mods folder.[/color][/size][/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]You can find all the playground equipment in the "Playground Catalogue", purchased from Robin for 500g.

For flooring, just use AT's paint bucket (also purchased from Robin) on gravel path, crystal floor, and hardwood fences. Gravel paths can become an enclosed woodchip area or basic grass. Crystal floors can become flat tiles of various colors. Hardwood fences can become colorful fences. 

You can sit on most of the equipment, but for some seats you need to approach them from above.  [b]Also be careful when you sit on an object placed near a wall (or map border): it’s rare, but you might get stuck in the wall when you stand up[/b] (Sesi recommended [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3900]Noclip Mode[/url], but I have not tested this personally).[/color]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Sesi5]Sesi5[/url] for the original mod![/color][/size]
